sentences.en: We used the transcripts of the recordings of telephone conversations.
sentences.zh: 我们使用了电话录音的文字稿。

sentences.en: The student center is a good place to strike up conversations.
sentences.zh: 学生中心是开始交谈的好地方。

sentences.en: When you enter a conversation, you should have something to say.
sentences.zh: 当你加入一场对话时，你应该有话可说。

senses.zh: 交谈，会话；社交；交往，交际；会谈；（人与计算机的）人机对话
